author: Rosa Martinez Gaugler
text: I noticed this reset happened more often the more I kept track of meals and meds in the app. I started using gluroo to track all of that and haven't had a reset since December. Also got my A1c down to 5.7 using both in conjunction because of some of the gluroo features. My Dr wishes all the info was on one app, but they work well together for me.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: All records are permanently recorded at the website . . . www.libreview.com. Just login using the same credentials as used on your phone ( or reader ) . . . In addition when you’re at your next medical appointment, ask them to connect their office to the Libra website… That way they can look at your records anytime they want and you’ll not have to prepare anything for the next appointment because they’ll already have it.

author: Gene Holcombe
text: The system never loses its data.  It’s stored at Libreview.com   Your doctors office can read all data if you connect them to your system.   Please do some reading on this and learn.
